Kill [[Sarnia the Red-Handed]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Sarnia the Red-Handed]] in [[North Kryta Province (War in Kryta)|North Kryta Province]]
* *BONUS* Kill Sarnia the Red-Handed in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 3 [[War Supplies]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 1 War Supply.

==Walkthrough==

Since Sarnia is an [[assassin]], skills that deal damage on attacks are highly effective, such as [[Spiteful Spirit]], [[Empathy]], or [[Insidious Parasite]]. Note that hexes and conditions last only half their normal duration because Sarnia is a [[Natural_Resistance|Prophecies boss]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Wanted by the Shining Blade
:''"Sarnia the Red-Handed is a [[White Mantle]] criminal who has abused the trust placed in her by common Krytans. A thief and murderer, Sarnia does not deserve to call herself a true Krytan. Allies of the Throne will receive a generous bounty when final justice is meted out to Sarnia."''
;After completion of The Battle for Lion's Arch
:''"Re-create this classic bounty hunt from the War in Kryta! Sarnia the Red-Handed was a White Mantle criminal who abused the trust placed in her by common Krytans. A thief and murderer, Sarnia did not deserve to call herself a true Krytan, and met her fate at the hands of bounty hunters in the service of Salma. Earn your royal bounty when you eliminate this menace once again from the pages of history!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll do whatever I can to help restore order to Kryta.
| decline = War! What is it good for?
| ask = If you wish to dispense justice, slay Sarnia the Red-Handed in North Kryta Province.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Princess Salma
:''"Thank you <Character name>, your efforts bring us one step closer to a unified nation."''

==Notes==
*Sarnia will not spawn when you have the quest [[Defend North Kryta Province]] active.
